desc:
Houses stand along a straight road at the positions listed in houses (several houses can share a position). A radio tower must be built on top of a house and reaches every house whose distance from the tower is at most r, in both directions. A house with a tower on it is, of course, covered.

Return the minimum number of towers needed so that every house is within reach of at least one tower.

houses = [7, 2, 4, 6, 5, 9, 12, 11], r = 2  ->  3

Towers at 4 (covers 2 to 6), at 9 (covers 7 to 11) and at 12 give full coverage.
hints: Look at the leftmost house that is not covered yet. It must be covered by a tower somewhere in the window [x - r, x + r].
Towers must stand on houses. Among the houses at positions up to x + r, which tower position reaches furthest to the right while still covering x?
Choose the rightmost house that is at most x + r (it covers x because the distance is at most r). Then skip all houses up to tower + r and repeat. Sort first and use a binary search or two pointers.
editorial: Sort the positions. Let x be the leftmost uncovered house. A tower that covers it sits on a house at position t with x - r ≤ t ≤ x + r, and since everything left of x is covered, the best tower is the one reaching furthest to the right, which means the largest t that is still a house position and at most x + r. That rightmost-feasible choice dominates all others by the usual exchange argument.

After placing the tower at t, every house up to t + r is covered, so jump to the first house beyond it. With a sorted array and a pointer this is linear after sorting: first move the pointer forward while houses[j] ≤ x + r to find the tower, then forward again while houses[j] ≤ t + r. Total O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
solution:
def minTowers(houses, r):
    pos = sorted(houses)
    n = len(pos)
    i = 0
    towers = 0
    while i < n:
        x = pos[i]
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and pos[j + 1] <= x + r:
            j += 1
        t = pos[j]
        towers += 1
        i = j + 1
        while i < n and pos[i] <= t + r:
            i += 1
    return towers
